newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS - DUAL LISTINGS LEAD SLOW WEEK.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS - DUAL LISTINGS LEAD SLOW WEEK.

text.p: dominated by dealing in dual-listed Metropolitan Life and
McCarthy Retail shares, the Namibian Stock Exchange said.
The NSE Overall Index ended the week at 247.54 points, down
from 251.23 points last week. The NSE Local Index reached 166.77
The total value of dealing was N$3.8 million for a total
First National Bank fo Namibia closed at N$4.00 per share
from starting the week at N$3.95. Gold Fields Namibia rose to
N$3.00. Namibia Breweries traded up to N$3.10 per share.
